picks.name: Trolley Route
picks.source_note: Dekmantel already seeded. New alias discovery -- Trolley Route is Oscar Mulero's techno-focused alias, making its Dekmantel UFO-series debut.
picks.bio: "New Visual Order" (November 6, 2026, Dekmantel, cat. DKMNTL-UFO23) is a four-track EP from Trolley Route, Oscar Mulero's alias (revived in 2023), marking his first release on Dekmantel's UFO series.
picks.why_listen: Straight, hypnotic techno from a veteran Spanish producer -- a solid, no-frills driver for a peak techno stretch of a set.

picks.name: XTAL
picks.source_note: Mule Musiq already seeded. New artist discovery -- his label debut.
picks.bio: "Off-Axis" (October 2, 2026, Mule Musiq) is a four-track EP and the label debut of XTAL, a Japanese DJ/producer (half of Kawasaki duo Traks Boys since '95) making solo productions since 2016 -- minimal loops and dubby, off-kilter rhythms across tracks "Off-Axis," "Arches," "Lilt," and "Morse Signals."
picks.why_listen: Understated, dubby tech house with a loose, rolling groove -- good for a late-night, head-down stretch of a set.
